# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.24

Smooth scrolling on title pages while a trailer plays, a Home spotlight that loops, and subtitles
that stay on screen when you zoom the picture.

## What's New

**A Home spotlight that keeps going**
The spotlight at the top of Home now loops. Swipe on from the last title and you are back at the
first; swipe back from the first and you reach the last. It also carries on to the first title by
itself after the last one, instead of rewinding through everything in between, and tapping a dot
takes the shortest way to that title.

## Improvements

**Smooth title pages while a trailer plays**
Scrolling a title page no longer freezes for a second or two at a time while its trailer plays.
Keeping your watch progress in step with your other devices used to hold up the page every few
seconds, and the trailer froze along with it, which looked like buffering. That work now happens in
the background, so the page and the trailer stay smooth.

**Lighter syncing on title pages**
A title page now checks the account only for the title you are looking at, rather than your whole
recent history, and stops checking altogether while the app is in the background. Progress from
your other devices still appears on the page within a few seconds while it is open.

## Fixed

- Fixed title pages and trailers stuttering or freezing briefly while scrolling. The freezes grew
  longer the more watch history an account had.
- Fixed subtitles being cut off or pushed off the screen when the picture was pinch-zoomed or set
  to fill the screen. Subtitles now stay in view however the picture is sized, in both players.
- Fixed a title page left open behind the home screen continuing to check for progress updates
  until the app was closed.

## Quick Setup

- **Nothing to set up:** These changes apply automatically after updating.
